metaDescription: Ontario Light Shows won our 2026 Permanent Outdoor Lighting award for Toronto, Ontario. Music-synced LED installs from roofline accents to parades.
summary: Ontario Light Shows designs music-synchronized, addressable LED lighting for homes, businesses and public events, from permanent roofline accents to large-scale parade productions. The company runs professional DMX and Art-Net control hardware and has powered more than 65 live events across Ontario.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: Ontario Light Shows offers experiential lighting, architectural accenting, RGB architectural lighting, immersive light displays and permanent holiday lighting. The range covers both a homeowner's year-round permanent roofline system and much larger productions, like a synchronized parade or festival display, using individually controlled pixels rather than fixed-colour strings.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: Installations use IP67 or IP68-rated hardware, which is rated for regular exposure to water and dust, alongside professional DMX or Art-Net controllers, the same category of equipment used in commercial and event lighting. The company states its work has powered more than 65 live events and lit over 1.2 million pixels across Ontario, giving a sense of the scale it operates at compared to typical seasonal light installers.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: A community group in Blenheim credited the company with choreographing an entire parade rather than simply hanging lights, describing the crowd reaction as unforgettable for a small-town event. A Toronto homeowner said their permanent roofline install is invisible from the curb during the day, and described running warm white lighting most of the year with the option to switch to full RGB colour for holidays.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The company's stated service area runs from Chatham-Kent to Toronto, covering a wide swath of Ontario for both residential permanent lighting and larger public event productions. Homeowners and event organizers should confirm travel and scheduling specifics for their location and event date.

strengths: Works in individually addressable pixel lighting rather than fixed-colour strings, enabling music-synchronized shows and colour control.
Uses professional-grade DMX and Art-Net control hardware, the standard for commercial and event lighting.
Has completed 65-plus live events and installed over 1.2 million pixels, indicating substantial production capacity.
Offers permanent, year-round roofline accent lighting alongside one-off event and parade productions.
Uses IP67/IP68-rated weatherproof hardware suited to outdoor, all-season installation.
considerations: Best suited to homeowners and event organizers wanting programmable, addressable lighting, not simple string lights; ask about cost differences upfront.
Large-scale event and parade productions require significant lead time to design and choreograph; book well ahead of your event date.
Not a fit for a same-week request during peak holiday season; permanent lighting installs are typically scheduled months in advance.
Expect a design consultation before pricing, since projects range from a single roofline to a multi-thousand-pixel public event.
bestFor: Homeowners wanting permanent, app or remote-controlled roofline lighting for year-round use
Event organizers planning a music-synchronized light show or parade
Businesses wanting architectural accent lighting for a storefront or facility
Communities and organizations planning a large public holiday lighting event
questionsToAsk: What control system does our installation use, and can we adjust colours and schedules ourselves after install?
How is the hardware rated for our climate, and what is the expected lifespan before maintenance is needed?
For an event or parade, how far in advance do you need to begin design and choreography?
What warranty or service plan applies to a permanent residential installation?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: Ontario Light Shows was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top permanent outdoor lighting business serving Toronto, Ontario, based on public services, reviews and stated project scale, with no fee for consideration or winning.

faq.q: Do they only do permanent home lighting, or also events?
faq.a: Both. Services include permanent holiday lighting for homes as well as large-scale experiential and immersive light displays for public events and parades.

faq.q: Is the lighting weatherproof for year-round Ontario use?
faq.a: The company states its hardware is IP67/IP68-rated, a rating associated with strong resistance to water and dust exposure, suited to outdoor installation.

faq.q: How far does their service area extend?
faq.a: The company describes its work as spanning from Chatham-Kent to Toronto, covering a broad area of Ontario.
